source_assumptions: The enforced action class has an owner-controlled Admission Profile with mandatory predicates.
trace: Requester selects an empty mandatory-predicate set or self-declared trusted validator.
Executor treats that requester-selected profile as sufficient.

observations: Caller-selected obligations cannot replace the trusted profile.

cases.rationale: A caller cannot weaken the predicate set or define its own trust root.

source_assumptions: A trusted owner defines a legitimate profile that requires only the predicates actually needed for this action class.
trace: Requester identifies the action class.
Owner-controlled selector chooses the known profile/version.
All profile-mandatory predicates validate at the declared boundary.

observations: No unnecessary external-evidence requirement is invented.

cases.rationale: A small trusted profile is valid when it is owner-defined rather than caller-selected.

source_assumptions: Approval/DecisionBasis is bound to revision A, account A and target A.
trace: Material revision/account/target changes to B.
Old approval is reused without rebuilding the current basis.

observations: Approval for A does not authorize B.

cases.rationale: ActionRevision and authority scope are material bindings.

source_assumptions: Revision, account, target, policy/profile and all current witnesses are unchanged and still valid.
trace: Previously issued exact-scope evidence is revalidated under K03.
The same bound effect reaches its declared boundary.

observations: Still-valid immutable evidence may be reused without reacquisition.

cases.rationale: K03 requires current validity, not mandatory reacquisition of unchanged immutable evidence.

source_assumptions: Provider A may have committed; its response was lost.
No proven cancellation/fencing/equivalence rule makes substitution safe.
trace: Attempt A becomes POSSIBLY_DISPATCHED.
Executor sends an equivalent effect to provider B because a local shared id matches.

observations: Provider A possible effect remains under custody.
No unaccounted provider-B effect is permitted.

cases.rationale: Provider substitution cannot manufacture exactly-once behavior from a local id.

source_assumptions: Provider A acceptance is ambiguous.
No supported cross-provider failover guarantee exists.
trace: Attempt A remains POSSIBLY_DISPATCHED.
Executor retains custody and reconciles provider A.
No provider-B mutation is emitted.

observations: Uncertainty is preserved and no second effect is created.

cases.rationale: Safe containment is a valid trace even though business completion is unresolved.

source_assumptions: The external effect can survive the executing process.
trace: Executor dispatches the external mutation.
Process crashes before the first durable attempt/custody record.

observations: Restart cannot reconstruct accountable ownership of the possible effect.

cases.rationale: Recoverable custody must exist before an effect may escape.

source_assumptions: Durable attempt storage and journal are available.
trace: Executor persists reconstructable EffectIdentity/attempt custody.
Boundary entry is durably marked POSSIBLE_EFFECT.
External dispatch occurs.
Process loss still leaves recoverable attribution.

observations: Restart recovers the same effect rather than minting a replacement.

cases.rationale: Existing durable local custody is sufficient when its failure model is explicit.

source_assumptions: Observation is permanently unavailable or provider history expires.
trace: Owner converts unresolved outcome to success, safe retry, or drops custody to clear the case.

observations: Knowledge remains UNKNOWN.
Blind replay and orphaned continuing work remain prohibited.

cases.rationale: Administrative pressure cannot upgrade unavailable evidence.

source_assumptions: The trusted Closure Profile defines a bounded evidence horizon and authorized residual-risk owner.
Residual external work is absent or explicitly bounded and under named custody.
trace: Evidence horizon is exhausted.
All obtainable observations and contradictions are retained.
Authorized owner retires active investigation as terminal UNKNOWN.

observations: Current knowledge remains UNKNOWN.
No safe-retry, success or budget-release inference is created.

cases.rationale: K04 permits bounded administrative retirement without epistemic upgrade.

source_assumptions: A stale worker can still reach the destination.
No destination CAS/idempotency/fencing rule prevents duplicate effect.
trace: New owner takes custody based only on a local ownership label.
Stale worker later emits another conflicting effect.

observations: Already accepted external work remains tracked.
False exclusivity is not advertised.

cases.rationale: Local ownership is not downstream fencing.

source_assumptions: The domain either has effective destination fencing/CAS or forbids automated takeover while stale execution may still act.
trace: Recovery identifies the original effect lineage.
Current owner re-establishes required authority/state.
Only a safe remaining effect proceeds, or takeover remains blocked.

observations: No stale-owned second effect is created.

cases.rationale: Takeover is valid only within the real exclusivity guarantee of the destination.

source_assumptions: The requested CRM patch is not fully satisfied.
trace: An unrelated timestamp or whole-object digest changes.
Executor reports VERIFIED/APPLIED from that unrelated change.

observations: Typed PARTIAL/UNSATISFIED/UNKNOWN evidence must be retained instead.

cases.rationale: Only the exact requested fields on the exact target can establish the intended postcondition.

source_assumptions: The exact bound customer and requested fields are observable under aegis.eep/crm-postcondition/v1.
trace: Bound PATCH attempt is made or state was already satisfied.
Stable observation shows every requested field has the requested JSON value on the exact target.

observations: Postcondition result is VERIFIED or ALREADY_SATISFIED as applicable.
Request acceptance remains separately typed.

cases.rationale: Useful success remains permitted when the scoped domain oracle is actually satisfied.

source_assumptions: Profile requires a destination-enforced version precondition.
trace: Executor reads version 4.
Competing writer advances state to version 5.
Executor mutates using only the stale read or an unprotected reread, without required destination CAS.

observations: A prior/current-looking observation is not atomicity.

cases.rationale: Exact-state admission cannot permit a write that omits its required destination guard.

source_assumptions: Destination supports the profile-required CAS/conditional mutation.
Version 4 remains current until acceptance.
trace: Executor binds version 4 in the ActionRevision/DecisionBasis.
Destination atomically enforces version 4 with the mutation.
Scoped postcondition is subsequently observed.

observations: Destination, not a prior read, enforces the hard precondition.

cases.rationale: The contract permits useful mutation when the claimed atomic guard actually exists.

source_assumptions: Trusted CI profile is selected by the owner-controlled verifier.
ActionRequest binds repository/run attempt/head/workflow/job identity.
Temporal and authority dependencies are current.
trace: One selective rerun request crosses the GitHub boundary.
Dispatch receipt records API acceptance only.
A genuine later execution re-runs the same failed step and that step succeeds.

observations: Dispatch acceptance and later validated recovery remain separate facts.

cases.rationale: Demonstrates useful permitted CI behavior without treating the dispatch receipt as downstream success.

source_assumptions: Trusted node-drain profile, current authority, exact plan, node revision and Pod UIDs are bound.
Required destination/API preconditions are available.
trace: Cordon/eviction effects execute within the declared plan.
Checkpoint records completed exact effects.
Postflight observes node unschedulable, no unexpected workload Pods and each planned Pod UID absent.

observations: Postflight MATCH applies to the exact plan/effect lineage.

cases.rationale: Demonstrates useful bounded mutation and automatic closure without a manual case.

source_assumptions: aegis.eep/crm-http-json/v1 and crm-postcondition/v1 are selected.
Destination/account/customer/ETag/plan are bound and current.
trace: Durable custody is established.
PATCH uses If-Match at the destination.
Destination returns 2xx.
Stable observations verify every requested field on the exact customer.

observations: RequestAcceptance=ACCEPTED.
Postcondition=VERIFIED.
Observation=OBSERVED_STABLE.

cases.rationale: Demonstrates useful automatic CRM mutation with destination CAS and a truthful scoped outcome.

source_assumptions: The exact bound pre-mutation customer state already satisfies every requested field.
trace: Executor verifies the scoped precondition state.
No PATCH is dispatched.

observations: RequestAcceptance=NOT_DISPATCHED.
Postcondition=ALREADY_SATISFIED.

cases.rationale: A legitimate no-op remains useful behavior and does not fabricate provider acceptance.
